title: 基礎生物学
subtitle: Basic Biology
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) the role of various substances common to all organisms. (2) the mechanism of metabolism. (3) the importance of biodiversity. (4) about various ecosystems and the system of environmental destruction. (5) the mechanism of gene expression and cell division.
advice: This is a basic biology course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Small molecules and the chemistry of life 2. Energy, enzymes, and metabolism 3. Biodiversity and the interconnectedness of life 4. Energy flow through ecosystems 5. Control of gene expression 6. Cell division and sexual reproduction Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are expected to work together in groups to complete tasks in class. Students should pay attention to the teacher’s instructions in the class since the schedule for quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should attend all classes as the handouts may not be received. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before each class.
books: Textbooks:Daigakusei no tameno kangaete manabu Kisoseibutsugaku (Kyoritsu Shuppan) Reference books:Seibutsugaku jiten (Iwanami Shoten) Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of biology. Basic computer skills. Students are requested to prepare for and review each class.
